_: The site (make site → dist/, make serve, make deploy). url — the address; langs — languages, default_lang — the site root. author — texts about the author (site/author.json). stories — the stories on the site in order: story — the story (stories/<id>), voicings — narrations by language (reading with highlighting and MP3), videos — video versions: production — the production (stories/<id>: paper theatre, Tarkovsky…), name/about — the caption on the site (the style, briefly; no retelling — no spoilers), poster — the cover shot (a storyboard shot id, a share of the shot). Video formats — vertical (film) and the production's formats.horizontal; languages — film.voicings (the video in the page's language, otherwise in the storyboard's).
author: site/author.json
